name: Pont-Aven School
summary: A loose circle of painters in a Breton village, where an artists’ colony grew from the 1850s. Gauguin came in 1886; he and Bernard worked there on flat areas of colour with dark outlines, a manner that critics named Synthetism. The circle has no firm end date.

statement.text: Paint from memory and feeling, with flat colour and a strong outline, and do not copy the scene as the eye sees it.
statement.title: Synthetist method

moves.text: Sérusier painted The Talisman under the direction of Gauguin in the Bois d'Amour at Pont-Aven.
Gauguin, Bernard and their friends showed together as the Impressionist and Synthesist Group at the Café Volpini in Paris.
